fill: each element holds at most one placeholder, alone, after a fixed prefix or before a fixed suffix; it is filled in one pass (before + value + after) and a value is never read again; into loses its trailing '/' first; cache_dir is given as it is

targets.rule: a video's or a download's target is exactly watch_url of an id video_id matches whole (re.fullmatch, the pattern having no anchors), else no run is made

refuse.rule: no run is made of a value in no_nul that holds a NUL, of an empty search target, or of a download whose into is empty once its trailing '/' are taken off

blocked.pattern: not a bot|HTTP Error 4(?:03|29)|Too Many Requests|rate[- ]limited|try again later|captcha

unavailable.pattern: Video unavailable|Private video|confirm your age|age[- ]restricted|available in your country|members[- ]only|has been removed|has been terminated|copyright|live event will begin|Premieres in|DRM protected|This video is (?:un|not )available

outdated.pattern: Unable to extract|nsig extraction failed|Signature extraction failed|Failed to extract any player response|Precondition check failed|challenge solving failed

degraded.pattern: n challenge solving failed|Signature solving failed|Error solving .{0,40}challenge request|No supported JavaScript runtime could be found|Challenge solver \S+ script version|Hash mismatch on challenge solver|Failed to (?:load|read builtin) challenge solver|nsig extraction failed|Signature extraction failed

network.pattern: \[Errno|Temporary failure|timed out|Connection (?:reset|refused|aborted)|Network is unreachable|Remote end closed|HTTP Error 5\d\d

classify.order: the gate's log first (its step, the runner's), then the exit status (ok_exit is ok_class whatever stderr says), then the steps over stderr
classify.lines: str.splitlines, each str.strip()ped; empty lines and those beginning skip_prefix dropped

over.error_line: the last line read that begins error_prefix, that word taken off and the rest str.strip()ped: one line or none
over.warning_lines: every line read that begins warning_prefix, whole
over.gate_log: the app's gate's log of the run, never stderr

steps.note: the phone's runner's, before stderr is read: a refusal of the app's gate, or its 407, is decided from the gate's log; classify never sees it

answers.no_such_video: yt-dlp answered for no such video

unwanted.pattern: \bcover(?:s|ed)?\b|翻唱|カバー|\blive\b|\ben vivo\b|\bao vivo\b|\ben directo\b|\bconcert\b|\bunplugged\b|现场|現場|演唱会|演唱會|ライブ|\bkaraoke\b|\binstrumental\b|\bbacking track\b|\bminus one\b|伴奏|カラオケ|노래방|\blesson\b|\btutorial\b|\bhow to play\b|\bchords?\b|\btabs?\b|\bguitar\b|教学|教學|吉他|\bslowed\b|\breverb\b|\bsped up\b|\bspeed up\b|\bnightcore\b|\b8d\b|\bbass boosted\b|\b\d+ hours?\b|\bloop\b|\breact(?:s|ion|ing)?\b|\bremix\b|\bmashup\b|\bparody\b|\bacoustic\b|\bpiano\b|\bdrum\b|\bin the style of\b|\b(?:as )?made famous by\b|\boriginally performed by\b

script_run.pattern: [ᄀ-ᇿ぀-ヿ㐀-䶿一-鿿가-힯豈-﫿𠀀-𮯯]+|[^ᄀ-ᇿ぀-ヿ㐀-䶿一-鿿가-힯豈-﫿𠀀-𮯯]+

choose.key: of the videos that fit, the least of (tier, -title, closeness, -official, rank): tier 1 for a version unwanted or not the song's own variant, else 0; title exact or alone; closeness 0 to 3 (3 with no length); official 3 the artist's Topic channel, 2 official audio, 1 the artist's own channel or an official video, else 0; rank the search's order

search.spent_why: no more YouTube asks this hour ({n} spent)
search.order: a search's gate: no word in the query (query_key empty), a sheet on the screen or the route off: none; then found or none (a record of the key within asked_for_days: its video an object, found), spent while cooling (cooling_why), spent with searches_per_hour runs named run… of the last hour in events (spent_why), failed (own_failed_why, else failures_why once failures_pause did within failed_for_seconds), else auto; a video's gate the same of video_key + its id, off (off_why) where YouTube is turned off
search.on_screen: a sheet on the screen: a song of your library scored strong or more not by its artist alone, a song of UG's index strong or more, an artist either index names whole (not part) strong or more, or a LaCuerda song strong or more with a sheet

record.rule: kv prefix + song id, json.dumps' text of fields in this order, then missing_at when it is set; read back: a text field a non-empty str or none, skip its str items, failures its int (bool too) values, video as Video.from_json reads it (an id video_id matches whole, str(title or ''), str(channel or ''), a number's float duration)

video_cmd.wont_give: Nothing found: YouTube won't give video {id} ({unavailable}).
video_cmd.turned_back: YouTube turned us back ({error}); no yt-dlp runs until {until}.
video_cmd.no_runs: no YouTube runs left. Try again later.
video_cmd.thumb_blocked: YouTube's images turned us back; waiting until {until}

search_cmd.no_word: {query} has no word to search for.
search_cmd.none_lately: Nothing found: YouTube had no video for {query} lately.
search_cmd.none_now: Nothing found: YouTube has no video for {query}.

gate.refusal: yt-dlp asked for {host}, which caracole doesn't allow
gate.stopped_said: caracole's gate stopped taking yt-dlp's connections

runner.timed_out: yt-dlp took longer than {timeout:g} s and was stopped
runner.no_audio_left: yt-dlp left no audio file in {folder}
